Literary fragments and illustrations build a world of enigmatic characters, symbols and scenes that blur the boundaries between the human and the divine. The editorial design combines Gothic lettering, ornamental borders and a palette of dark tones, gold accents and warm backgrounds. Text and image interact across each spread, bringing visual unity to the team’s contributions.

Camino a la Esperanza es un juego de mes: Camino a la Esperanza is a board game inspired by the film Children of Men. It turns the search for a destination into a journey across a gridded board placed over a box containing a maze. A die determines how many steps to move, with the aim of reaching the lighthouse from the starting point. Illustrations, weathered textures and deep blue tones create an atmosphere of uncertainty in which every move offers a new possibility to keep going.
El laberinto representa los obstáculos d: The maze represents the obstacles along the way, while the lighthouse offers a guiding point. The project’s symbol brings these forms together with a figure holding a baby and a boat above the waves. The visual design connects the game’s journey with ideas of protection, resilience and hope, carried through the packaging, board and playing pieces.
